blocks.text: BANGKOK — The Thai Meteorological Department (TMD) issued a five-day warning on October 8, 2026, forecasting thundershowers, gusty winds, hail and isolated heavy to very heavy rain in parts of Thailand during October 9–13. Bangkok included in October 10–11 warning Bangkok and surrounding provinces are included in the TMD’s warning for October 10–11, while the South features throughout the five-day period.
